title: Best of Vietnam and Cambodia in 15 Days
highlights: Unveil the hidden gems of Vietnam and Cambodia, from bustling cities to serene countryside retreats.
Experience the magic of Halong Bay with kayaking, swimming, and cave exploration amidst stunning limestone formations.
Admire the majestic Lady Buddha statue, a 67-metre marvel overlooking the city, at Linh Ung Pagoda.
Explore the complex network of tunnels, including living quarters, hospitals, and command centres, within the Cu Chi Tunnels.
Marvel at the architectural grandeur of Angkor Wat, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, renowned for its intricate carvings and towering structures.
overview:
About the Tour:
Discover the rich history, myths, and natural beauty of Vietnam and Cambodia, two of South Asia's emerging travel destinations. Vietnam offers stunning landscapes with towering cliffs, scenic rivers, and a captivating coastline, while its war-affected sites add a touch of history and adventure.
Cambodia, known for its rich culture and spirituality, showcases the grandeur of ancient temple ruins, including UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Experience the charm of Cambodia’s countryside as you cruise through Tonle Sap Lake in a traditional boat, creating unforgettable memories.

know_before_you_go: Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.

ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms, shoulders, knees, and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Images are only for representation purposes.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Commence your Vietnamese adventure with an arrival at the Noi Bai International Airport, followed by a pre-booked transfer to your hotel for check-in. Relax and unwind before immersing yourself in the vibrant energy of Hanoi. Explore the city's iconic landmarks on your own, including the serene Hoan Kiem Lake adorned with the iconic Huc Bridge, and the Ngoc Son Temple, dedicated to General Tran Hung Dao. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi at 02:00 PM

days.title: Day Trip to Ninh Binh
days.desc: Embark on a day trip to Ninh Binh by getting transferred to explore the former capital of Vietnam, Hoa Lu. Visit its ancient temples dedicated to the Dinh and Le dynasties. Then, enjoy a scenic boat ride through Tam Coc, surrounded by towering limestone formations and emerald waters. Conclude your journey with a leisurely bike ride through charming villages, passing by rice paddies and local life, before visiting Bich Dong Pagoda. Later, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Cruise
days.desc: Get ready for a cruise adventure after checking out of the hotel and getting transferred to Halong Bay. Upon arrival, embark on a Halong Bay cruise at Tuan Chau Harbour. Stop by Ti Top Island and Pearl Farm Village to enjoy recreational activities like kayaking and swimming. Also, learn how to cook Vietnamese cuisine onboard. Conclude your day with an overnight stay in the cabin as the cruise glides through the limestone karst (hollowed rock formations) and pristine waters of Halong Bay.

Halong Bay Overnight Cruise on a Shared basis on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Begin your overnight cruise from Tuan Chau Tourist Wharf in Halong Bay and receive a warm welcome with a delicious lunch and drinks. 
Take a small boat to explore neighbouring islands, relax at their coast or take a swim, before proceeding to visit the Pearl Farm village for an interactive experience. 
Learn about the traditional Vietnamese dishes and flavours during your cooking class on the cruise.

days.title: Visit to Surprise Cave | Transfer to Halong Bay
days.desc: As a new day dawns, continue your Halong Bay adventure by engaging in a Tai Chi (martial art) lesson and visiting the largest caves of Halong Bay, the Surprise Caves (also called the Sung Sot Cave). Following that, deboard the cruise and get transferred to Noi Bai International Airport for your flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival at Da Nang International Airport, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Halong Bay Cruise on a Shared basis on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Begin your day by practicing Tai Chi, the Chinese martial art, on the Sundeck. 
Next, take a small passenger boat to reach Surprise Cave (Sung Sot), Halong Bay's largest cave spanning 12,000 square meters and admire its natural scenery.
Get back on the cruise and head to Tuan Chau Harbor.

days.title: Excursion to Ba Na Hills
days.desc: Set out on a thrilling journey with a pre-booked transfer to Ba Na Hills, famous for its natural beauty and exciting attractions. Ascend to the summit via a cable car ride, from the Suoi Mo Station to Marseille Station. Explore the iconic Golden Hand Bridge, a feat of engineering, and visit the Linh Ung Pagoda, home to the largest outdoor Lady Buddha statue in Vietnam. Also, head to the Fantasy Park and Debay Wine Cellar. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Hoi An
days.desc: On this day, get transferred to the ancient town of Hoi An, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, for a day trip. Explore the famous attractions of Hoi An by visiting places like the Japanese Covered Bridge and the Assembly Hall Of Fujian. Also, experience the tranquillity of the Thu Bon River on a leisurely boat ride (at an extra cost), witnessing the daily life of local fishermen. Finally, get dropped off at the hotel in Da Nang for an overnight stay.

days.title: Leisure Day in Phu Quoc
days.desc: Spend a leisurely day exploring the iconic attractions of Phu Quoc Island on your own. Rent a motorbike to witness the natural beauty of Suoi Tranh Waterfall, nestled amidst lush greenery. Afterwards, head to the pristine sands of Sao Beach, renowned for its crystal-clear waters. Conclude your day with a shopping spree in the vibrant atmosphere of the Phu Quoc Night Market, offering a diverse range of local goods and cuisine. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Ho Chi Minh City | Leisure Day
days.desc: Today, check out of the hotel and get transferred to Phu Quoc International Airport for your flight to Tan Son Nhat International Airport. Upon arrival, get driven to the hotel, check in & spend the rest of the day at leisure. Explore bars, clubs, and restaurants of Bui Vien Street, or stroll through Nguyen Hue Walking Street, famous for its vibrant nightlife. Also, attend a water puppet show at the Golden Dragon Water Puppet Theatre. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City Tour | Visit to the Cu Chi Tunnels
days.desc: Begin your day by boarding your pre-booked transfer to explore the iconic attractions of Ho Chi Minh City, including the Reunification Palace and the Saigon Central Post Office, a stunning example of French colonial architecture. Delve into the history of the Vietnam War at the War Remnants Museum before venturing to the Cu Chi Tunnels, a vast underground network showcasing the resilience of the Vietnamese people. Conclude your day by getting driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Siem Reap | Leisure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out of your hotel and get a transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for your flight to Siem Reap. Upon arrival at Siem Reap International Airport, check in to your hotel and enjoy the remainder of the day at your leisure. Explore the vibrant Pub Street, known for its lively nightlife and diverse dining options, or immerse yourself in the local culture by visiting the bustling Angkor Night Market. In the evening, head to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tonle Sap lake Boat Ride Tour
days.desc: In the morning, embark on a captivating journey as you get transferred to Tonle Sap Lake, Southeast Asia's largest freshwater body. Enjoy a relaxing boat ride through the expansive waters (at an extra cost), encountering floating villages like Chong Kneas, where you can immerse yourself in the culture and unique lifestyle of the local people. Finally, get dropped off at the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Angkor Wat
days.desc: Commence your day by getting transferred to Angkor Thom, where an exploration of the magnificent Angkor Wat complex awaits. Begin with the 12th-century Bayon Temple, known for its intricate stone carvings. Post that, head to the Royal Enclosure and visit several other iconic attractions on this day. Conclude your tour with a visit to Angkor Wat, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, famous for its extensive bas-reliefs (decorative sculptures). Later, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.
